tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search Dubai projects, communities, developers and areas by name (case- and accent-insensitive, all query words must match; exact > prefix > contains, then by number of sales).
    type: optional filter, one of project | community | developer | area.
    Returns for each hit: id ("type:slug"), title

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description:
Get the full statistics record for one project, community, developer or area by slug (the last part of its page address, e.g. dubai-marina).
    type: project | community | developer | area. Includes price and AED/sqft medians, year-on-year changes, off-plan share, bedroom breakdown, monthly price h

tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description:
Get the overall Dubai property market summary: sales count, median price and AED/sqft, year-on-year changes, off-plan share, bedroom and property-type breakdown, yearly history and recent monthly price series.
    Data: registered sales transactions from Dubai Land Department open data, updated dail

tools.name: get_monthly_report
tools.description:
Get the monthly Dubai property market report: key figures (sales, median price, AED/sqft, year-on-year), summary facts, top movers and a ready-made citation string.
    month: 'YYYY-MM'; omit for the latest report.
    Data: registered sales transactions from Dubai Land Department open data, updated

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Fetch the full readable record for one project, community, developer or area by its id ("type:slug", e.g. "community:dubai-marina") — the same text as the datadubai.ae page, as Markdown with figures, limits and a citation line.
    Returns id, title, text, url and metadata.
    Data: registered sale

tools.name: list_rankings
tools.description:
List top rankings. kind: rents (communities by median annual rent, AED), yields (communities by gross rental yield %), communities (by number of sales in last 12 months, with median price and AED/sqft) or developers (by number of sales).
    Each row includes a url. limit: 1-100.
    Data: registere

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, get_entity, get_market_summary, get_monthly_report, fetch, list_rankings · Private data: get_entity, fetch · Public sink: get_entity, get_market_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, get_entity, get_market_summary, get_monthly_report, fetch, list_rankings · Private data: get_entity, fetch · Public sink: get_entity, get_market_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
